text.en: Hilde Arrows, Ionization & Zero In
[Lead] Create 3 Homing Arrow in Draw Pile.
60% Damage and 2 Ionization to all enemies.
[Unique] [Lead] On Hit, 2 Zero In.

body.en:
Homing Arrows:
Attack Cards that Hilde Creates in the Draw Pile
Each Arrow has Attunement (On Draw): Activate itself
Activating it then does an Extra Attack + Draws 1 Card
ARROWS ARE NOT CARD POSTIVE OR NEGATIVE THEY ARE NEUTRAL
Unusable Cards also are considered 0 Cost
Ionization:
For every Ionization Stack the enemy takes +8% and +4% (Hilde only)
Max Stacks 12, so +8% x 12 = +96% which is barely 5 moral
Not very important at all
Zero In:
For every stack of Zero +35% into a SINGLE Extra Attack on Highest HP Opp
Max Stack 60, so +35% x 60 = 2100%
